scope: Frozen CP01-CP09 customer support journeys; reseller operations and staff invitations remain outside the first paid release

findings.risk: Intake accepts an enquiry, its response is lost, and browser storage failure leaves no stable reference after reload
findings.reproduction: Two component regressions dispatched one request despite denied storage or quota failure; expected zero
findings.repair: Persist the request reference before dispatch. On failure preserve the editable unsent draft and expose the existing email alternative without a sent claim

findings.risk: A customer loses the authenticator but cannot submit a saved recovery code because login strips non-digits and always sends the TOTP field
findings.reproduction: Three recovery-mode behavior tests failed; the advertised recovery action was absent. Existing ownership tests remained green
findings.repair: Expose the existing recovery-code API through a keyboard-accessible mode switch. Preserve alphanumeric codes, clear the prior credential when switching, and retain challenge, identity, duplicate-submit and unknown-outcome guards

findings.risk: Interrupted password-reset INCR/EXPIRE leaves a counter with no expiry, permanently suppressing later recovery messages
findings.reproduction: A legacy counter at the send cap retained TTL -1 after another request. The prior rate limiter also authorized sends when the rate claim failed
findings.repair: Use one Redis Lua operation for increment and expiry, repair missing legacy TTLs without resetting recorded attempts or extending healthy windows, and deny unconfirmed send claims behind the unchanged generic response

frontend_green.environment: Talklee-Installer-Test WSL, Node 22.22.0, fresh /tmp/talklee-customer-journeys-20261029 fixture, real copied source/import graph and direct dependencies selected from candidate package-lock.json
frontend_green.limitations: Component/HTTP-boundary tests only; no Next build, real browser, owned mailbox or provider acceptance. Release CI must use the qualified runtime and complete lockfile

billing_support_green.environment: Same isolated WSL dependency fixture, with source under Talk-Leee and sibling historical CP04 JSON artifacts. Added candidate-locked Next, React Query and user-event dependencies
billing_support_green.coverage: Includes integration lead's rendered support reference, retained uncertain purchase, hidden raw details, account-switch ownership, cancellation, delayed activation, invoice totals and refund semantics
billing_support_green.fixture_preparation: An initial attempt reported two missing historical fixture paths and one missing test dependency; corrected fixture layout/dependency before the 59/59 run
billing_support_green.limitations: Captured historical PostgreSQL contracts and mocked provider HTTP, not a new provider payment or refund test

backend_green.environment: Windows Python 3.12.12, existing tmp/inbound-test-venv; candidate backend source, pytest 7.4.4, fakeredis 2.40.0
backend_green.limitations: Local simulated Redis Lua and service-boundary verification. No live reset mail, production Redis or customer credentials used

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Designated real intake receipt, reachable mailbox, accountable owner and retention acceptance

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Designated Stripe account, authoritative purchased offer and actual payment/event reconciliation acceptance

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.review: Existing invoices and top-ups distinguish provider refund/accounting facts from bank receipt. Existing billing contact is documented; portal is the supported cancellation route
reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Mailbox operation, billing recipient and cancellation/effective-date acceptance; an unavailable portal cannot count as operating cancellation

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.review: Reseller operations and staff invitations are not reintroduced
Existing notification tests and code maintain verified tenant:user scope, revoke stale callbacks and isolate shared-browser identities
reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Actual supported notification delivery and shared-browser release acceptance; no new delivery or response-time promise

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.review: Recovery-code login and reset limiter repaired; signup/recovery mail-failure, reset-attempt and recovery-code regressions passed. First-call checklist remains navigation guidance, not readiness proof
reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Designated signup/reset mailbox, real recovery and first telephone call; support identity-verification procedure for customers without any recovery factor

reviewed_controls_and_open_acceptance.remaining: Deployed support-reference correlation, incident ownership, approved data-export/deletion escalation, customer acceptance and user-facing recovery documentation

release_statement: These repairs do not close CP packages, lift the feature freeze, establish live deployment, or certify paid production readiness. Existing operational, database, model-profile, provider and customer-acceptance gates remain explicit.
